scope: Room pool, profile order and Relay state machine with a scripted player. Rendering, audio and human playability are separate.

checks.name: Handoff keeps every visible room and leads with empty Lobby rooms
checks.detail: handoff room 3; first furnished room +3; cycle Shift, Office, Run, Exit, Lobby

checks.name: Two dressed rooms always wait ahead and no loaded room changes profile
checks.detail: walked 24 rooms; at least 2 rooms ready ahead every frame; 24 recycles

checks.name: A walking player is hunted but not caught; the Relay is released out of sight
checks.detail: released 13.4 s after the handoff in room +3; closest 4.4 m; 15 doors broken; 8 Run alarms; 1 rebases; final state Hunt

checks.name: A player who stops after the release is caught
checks.detail: stopped 13.5 s after the handoff; caught 22.7 s later after 2 door breaks

checks.name: A sprinting player escapes
checks.detail: sprinted 55 rooms in 120 s; Relay state BreakDoor; 43 relays
